Behind the image
27 / Studio Knot
REFERENCE 5780.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 022
Art direction: Natural beauty, effortless hair, soft studio light, minimal wardrobe.
Photorealistic vertical beauty portrait of an original adult East Asian woman facing the camera with
a calm, direct gaze. Dark brown hair in a loose, messy high top knot with wispy face-framing
strands, light natural freckles, dewy skin, dark brown eyes and soft pink-coral lips. She wears a
simple black lightweight crew-neck knit sweater. Smooth gray-to-blue gradient studio backdrop,
soft diffused frontal light, natural skin texture and fine flyaway hair detail, clean minimalist
editorial, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, no text or logos.
28 / Embroidered Vest
REFERENCE 5779.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 023
Art direction: Romantic folk-inspired styling, cream and floral color accents, soft natural shadows.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult East Asian
woman with long, wavy dark hair parted in the center, playful rosy blush across the cheeks and a
calm direct gaze. She wears a cropped ivory linen V-neck button-front vest embroidered with red,
pink, yellow and blue flowers and green stems, a tiered ruffle white mini skirt, a delicate gold heart
pendant necklace, and holds a black tote bag by its handles in front of her. Standing against a pale
cream plaster wall, soft natural window light with gentle shadows, warm neutral palette with floral
color accents, romantic folk-inspired contemporary fashion editorial, crisp embroidery detail, no
text or logos.
